versionPairs.description: A real Bun 1.3.14 build (`bun build --target=bun --format=cjs`, unminified) of an app that requires two of its own text files (`module.exports = "…"` / a template literal) and two vendored CommonJS modules, one of which requires its own text. Finding #88: the app's text modules are app assets under src/_assets/, named from their first line, never asked of the package namer, while the library's text stays vendored; and v1.1.0 lengthens one vendored module's error message (its structural hash moves), which the content carry pairs with v1.0.0's module so its vendor file keeps its path.
